'''Harloen''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|20|Harloen}}</ref> located in the [[Harloen system/Legends|Harloen system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Belsmuth sector/Legends|Belsmuth sector]].<ref name="EAOC Harloen" /> It was situated on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]], which served as the dividing line between the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] and the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] region and which connected it to the [[Botajef system/Legends|Botajef system]] and the [[Crombach Nebula/Legends|Crombach Nebula]] as well as the [[Bandomeer system/Legends|Bandomeer system]]<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Meerian sector/Legends|Meerian sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

Harloen was known as the [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the Outer Rim Territories. Similarly to worlds such as [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]] and [[Sorotarr VI]], by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Harloen was commonly frequented by people such as corporate executives; Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]], [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admirals]], and [[Noble/Legends|nobles]]; and dishonest individuals, who were all traveling incognito and were seeking out entertainment.<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Harloen was first mentioned in the [[1993]] [[West End Games]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'' that was written by [[Simon Smith]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann]].<ref name="GG9" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] placed the Harloen [[Star system/Legends|system]], and thereby the planet itself, in grid square O-6.<ref name="TEA" />
